scope: Proposition 2.4 (The limiting posterior) of the manuscript “The exact reconstruction threshold for the three-state symmetric channel” (preprints/The-exact-reconstruction-threshold-for-the-three-state-symmetric-channel-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 229 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e87d0854f29320d5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: On a common realization of the tree and spins, the root posterior likelihood vectors m(ℓ) converge almost surely to a vector m(∞). Their laws converge weakly to a symmetric balanced law Q∞ satisfying Q∞ = Rλ,D(Q∞). (2.17) The advantages aℓ and moments µℓ = Exℓ are nonincreasing and converge to their corresponding expecta- tions under Q∞. This holds throughout −1/2 ≤ λ ≤ 1, including parameters for which edge probabilities vanish.
